result:
I fixed the regression in `anthrouter/http_util.py`. `_RATELIMIT_HEADERS` was reading `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining`, but the real header is `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining` (plural). The singular name never matched, so the requests-remaining value was silently dropped from the recorded window.

I made the one-word fix there, not in the tests. The 6 tests matching `ratelimit` or `rate_limit` pass. I did not run the full suite, so I haven't checked for other failures, including any that predate this one.
